name: Treant Muisek
summary: Witch Doctor Uzer'i's next target is the wandering forest walkers, treants that slowly roam the forest. After the faerie dragons, you are sent to find three of them.

sections.title: Slow Protectors
sections.body: Uzer'i says the night elves have recruited treants as allies in their fight against the Horde. They move slowly, but Uzer'i calls their role as protectors undeniable, and plans to turn that power to the Horde's own benefit.

sections.title: Three Forest Walkers
sections.body: Uzer'i wants three wandering forest walkers found and killed, then each fallen treant shrunk and captured with the Muisek Vessel.

sections.title: Uzer'i's Verdict
sections.body: On your return Uzer'i thanks you and remarks that the collection of muisek is nearly complete.

faq.q: Who sends adventurers after the treants?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i, who asks for this right after the faerie dragons.

faq.q: Why does Witch Doctor Uzer'i want treant muisek?
faq.answer: Uzer'i says the night elves have recruited treants as allies in their fight against the Horde, and wants to use their protective power for the Horde's own benefit.

faq.q: What creatures must be found for Treant Muisek?
faq.answer: Wandering forest walkers, which roam the forest. Three of them are needed.
After a wandering forest walker falls, the Muisek Vessel is used to shrink it and capture it.

faq.q: Where does Treant Muisek fit among Uzer'i's requests?
aliases: what comes after faerie dragon muisek
faq.answer: It follows Faerie Dragon Muisek, and Mountain Giant Muisek comes after it.
